control_definitions.condition_mean_common_privileged: give every condition the mean true future across hidden conditions for that scene/candidate/horizon
control_definitions.current_state_displacement_scale: query_state + alpha * (true_future - query_state); Action Strength query_state comes from a source-verified sidecar of original frame index 2
control_definitions.exact_truth: prediction equals that unit's true future
control_definitions.fixed_norm_offset: add a deterministic displacement of the named norm along the first coordinate
control_definitions.history_blind_ceiling: binary-condition upper bound on the fraction of the two futures a single common point can cover at the specified tolerance
control_definitions.wrong_condition_true_future: assign each condition the next condition's true future in a deterministic cyclic shift

door.distribution: older TwoRoom multistep panels (2026-09-30), kept separate

speed.distribution: older TwoRoom multistep panels (2026-09-30), kept separate

provenance.derived_from: registered original Action Strength Development Lance data; no simulator
provenance.source_state_frame_semantics: four recorded frames are [initial, after context block 1, after context block 2/current query, after the source query action block]

scope_and_interpretation.calibration_error: These controls calibrate tolerance stringency; their scores are not rigorous floors for learned predictors because prediction errors can interact with or cancel target bias.
scope_and_interpretation.condition_mean_common: Privileged history-blind reference computed from both conditions' future labels; not an attainable prediction baseline.
scope_and_interpretation.history_blind_ceiling: For binary-condition tasks, per scene/candidate/horizon/object unit ceiling is 1 when true-target norm gap < 2*tau, otherwise 0.5. Speed has three conditions, so this binary formula is not applied and its ceiling is null.
scope_and_interpretation.macro_averaging: For each scene, mean equally across conditions and candidate futures at each horizon; then mean scene scores equally. Horizons remain separate.
scope_and_interpretation.nine_task_coverage: This validates the three current PushT visible-future tasks plus Speed and Door positive controls only; it does not validate the full nine-task release.
scope_and_interpretation.not_a_task_adequacy_claim: Tolerances are exploratory values borrowed from TAP-style pixel thresholds, not declared task-adequacy criteria.
scope_and_interpretation.pushT_coordinates: 512-world-pixel coordinates; candidate thresholds [2,4,8,16,32], equivalent to [1,2,4,8,16] source-256 px.
scope_and_interpretation.pushT_object_readout: agent = physical target dims [0:2]; block = dims [2:6] with 40*sin(theta),40*cos(theta); block norm is px-equivalent, not real point distance.
scope_and_interpretation.score: PCK-style fraction with Euclidean object error strictly less than tau
scope_and_interpretation.source_groups_and_intervals: No confidence intervals are reported, so no bootstrap source-group resampling or MD128 de-duplication is used.
scope_and_interpretation.twoRoom_coordinates: Direct 224x224 canvas px from TwoRoomEnv.IMG_SIZE and state coordinates; thresholds are [1,2,4,8,16] equivalent-256 px scaled by 224/256.
scope_and_interpretation.wrong_condition_control: Cyclic wrong-condition truth is a label-swapping control, not an empirical model baseline. For three-condition Speed the cyclic shift covers each unordered pair once across conditions.
